messages:
ana: proposal: add event_fingerprint BIGINT to analytics_events to get a compact stable dedupe key. use xxh64 over canonical tenant_id|route_sig|payload_digest. goals: cheaper joins, deterministic replay, and smaller saved-query diffs.

mike: index concerns. single large btree could hurt writes. partial WHERE event_kind IN ('route','quota')? or a bloom filter index? need numbers for write amplification.

ana: partial index seems safest. sample numbers: current write p50 1.1k/s, p99 bursts ~6.8k/s. we can scope index to the high-selectivity event_kinds.

sam: rollout idea: sidecar dualwrite that populates fingerprint (nullable). no outage. then run a background backfill to populate old rows. console reads should tolerate nulls.

jin: frontend UX: dashboards currently GROUP BY event_id. we should implement fallback dedupe: if fingerprint IS NOT NULL use it, else use event_id+route. feature-flag the strict fingerprint path.

leo: saved-query risk: queries referencing event_id must be surfaced. I can run a query audit to tag saved queries that rely on event_id grouping or distinct counts. carla (PM) should review.

carla: will prioritize saved-query audit and reviewers. flag any dashboard used in top-50 active orgs.

mike: backfill options: 1) in-place PG backfill with chunked updates; 2) populate OLAP shadow (ClickHouse) and have console join there during migration; 3) hybrid: backfill critical tenant shards first. tradeoffs: PG hurts primary write latency, CH adds operational join complexity.

sam: suggested backfill runner: tenant-windowed jobs, hourly windows, id-range chunking, concurrency capped by p99 write latency SLA. emit per-tenant progress metrics and ETA. implement checkpointing to resume.

ana: SQL migration sketch:

    ALTER TABLE analytics_events ADD COLUMN event_fingerprint BIGINT NULL;
    CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY analytics_events_fingerprint_idx ON analytics_events (event_fingerprint) WHERE event_kind IN ('route','quota');

sam: add note: use CONCURRENTLY to avoid locks; test worst-case impact in staging with replayed write load.

jin: monitoring & validation: run alert parity test for 72h where alerts compute metrics via both methods (legacy & fingerprint). create regression detector that fails rollout if top-200 metrics differ >0.3%.

mike: storage estimate: +8 bytes/row = ~8GB per 1B rows. index size depends on selectivity; partial index should be <20% of full index. will run estimate job.

leo: during rollout, console should offer a "migration mode" toggle per-org to opt into fingerprint-based dedupe early. UI teams want a flag for staged opt-ins.

ana: security: fingerprint must be non-reversible. hashing spec: xxh64(hex(tenant_id)||"|"||route_sig||"|"||payload_digest) then cast to signed BIGINT. no PII in inputs.

sam: ops-bot: queueing migration canary in staging for schema + dualwrite test. please include telemetry replay artifacts.

ops-bot: canary job scheduled: schema-fingerprint-canary-1767888888 -> https://ci.redwood/migrations/1767888888 (ETA 15m) :gear:

mike: extra mitigation: create a lightweight materialized view rollups_by_fp refreshed hourly for heavy dashboards so we avoid per-query backfill joins.

jin: agree. also add a compatibility rewrite layer that transparently maps existing saved queries to use fp when available. keep audit trail for manual review.

sam: owners: sam -> dualwrite + backfill runner; mike -> index sizing & perf sim; jin -> console fallback + query rewrite; leo -> saved-query audit; carla -> PM review + priority list.

ana: rollout gates: dualwrite live -> backfill 50% -> alerts parity 72h -> backfill 95% -> flip fingerprint flag org-by-org. also require no regression >0.3% on top-200 metrics for 7 days.

mike: fine. I'll run staging perf sim and post numbers in this thread.

ops-bot: canary job finished: schema-fingerprint-canary-1767888888  SUCCESS. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/migrations/1767888888/artifacts

leo: I'll kick off saved-query audit and surface dashboards that need PM signoff tomorrow morning.

ana: thanks all. I'll open PRs: migration DDL + sidecar change + hashing spec. tagging owners.

carla: thanks team. will sync with product ops to calendar PM reviews for flagged dashboards.

mike: posted initial storage/cost calc gist: https://gist.github.com/mike/index-sizing-fp (will update after staging runs).

ana: closing note: add a retro step to evaluate whether fp should also be used for quota accounting to avoid double-charging on replays. will add to INF-2150.

sam: noted, will include quota testcases in canary runner.
